headline: Asian Equities and Currencies Slip Ahead of Central Bank Meetings
summary: Asian stocks and chipmakers fell while the US dollar drifted lower as investors prepared for central bank meetings and corporate earnings. The Chinese yuan reached a four-year high.
why: Central bank monetary policy announcements and corporate earnings reports significantly influence global equity valuations and investor risk sentiment.

impacts.name: Semiconductors
impacts.why: Cautious sentiment ahead of central bank decisions and corporate earnings weighed on semiconductor shares.

why_moved: Equity markets pulled back as investors reduced risk exposure ahead of major central bank policy meetings and corporate earnings reports.
